counting_rule: An entry of a mapped Dockle code at the level INFO, WARN or FATAL is a finding. An entry at the level SKIP is a finding only if an alert is not a failed-to-detect notice; otherwise Dockle did not evaluate the checkpoint. The 2x2 table holds images where ConUnit is verified (PASS or FAIL) and Dockle evaluated the checkpoint. ConUnit UNVERIFIED, Dockle errors and checkpoints that Dockle did not evaluate are counted separately. Agreement is the raw share of images in the 2x2 table on which both tools agree. No chance-corrected statistic is computed.

"$APACHE_ENVVARS"; 	for dir in 		"$APACHE_LOCK_DIR" 		"$APACHE_RUN_DIR" 		"$APACHE_LOG_DIR" 		"$APACHE_RUN_DIR/socks" 	; do 		rm -rvf "$dir"; 		mkdir -p "$dir"; 		chown "$APACHE_RUN_USER:$APACHE_RUN_GROUP" "$dir"; 		chmod 1777 "$dir"; 	done; 		rm -rvf /var/www/html/*; 		ln -sfT /dev/stderr "$APACHE_LOG_DIR/error.log"; 	ln -sfT /dev/stdout "$APACHE_LOG_DIR/access.log"; 	ln -sfT /dev/stdout "$APACHE_LOG_DIR/other_vhosts_access.log"; 	chown -R --no-dereference "$APACHE_RUN_USER:$APACHE_RUN_GROUP" "$APACHE_LOG_DIR" # buildkit
